purpose: Resolve source taxon names and classify public observation coordinates as native, introduced or unresolved before constructing the primary ecological cohort.

source_taxonomy_and_distribution.dataset: World Checklist of Vascular Plants via GBIF dataset endpoints

name_resolution_rule: Resolve a source canonical name only when exact canonical-name records with usable accepted keys converge on one accepted WCVP key; otherwise unresolved.
distribution_rule: Blank or NATIVE establishment means on a non-doubtful present record are native; INTRODUCED is introduced; conflicts, doubtful, absent, unknown and unlisted states are not guessed.
geometry_rule: Assign a TDWG level-3 region only when a public coordinate lies within exactly one pinned polygon; boundary/overlap/unmapped points remain unresolved.
retention_rule: All observations remain in the master ledger. This join adds status and taxonomic provenance; it never deletes source observations.
primary_ecology_rule: Only observations explicitly classified native and otherwise meeting the separately frozen ecological support rules may enter primary ecological inference.
introduced_rule: Introduced observations may be used only in separately labelled range-transfer/transportability analyses, never as evidence defining the primary native-range association.
misidentification_boundary: Name resolution is not independent image-identification validation.
